book.title: APALYNAH JOHAN TEI A HMUHPAW APALYNAH BIA

content: Mataico vaicung lekhei khuarawha a chuipaw paching pakhanah alaipaw ahringpaw khah ka hmuh. Ahning caipaw ruhanah rawrungpaw sangsarih khatei a cangpaw vaiming pasarih khah hmuh he neh ka, ma heh a hningcaipaw cawh a cang, zecawtamaw tatah aaning khahei Khazing thingaenah cawh a tling thah.

Taico me khatei pahlawhpaw thlalang rili a lopaw khah hmuh neh ka, sawhrang le ama a lingthlaw le a ming nambar cung letah tenah a hnuitu sahlo khah Khazing tei a pehpaw he tingtang khah a tle he ka, ma rili cung lekhei a daw thlang he.
Khazing saecapaw Moses a hlaw le Tuu teitei a hlaw khah aa sah.

content.text: na hming tuapaw cawh rungnaw ka, ningang a chui,
mingphing vytei aa Siangpahrang na langpui cawh
a dingpaw le a hmuisuipaw a cang.
Vy Abuipaw, nama a ca ci lypaw le
na ming rungnawnah a ca pei lypaw cawh ahomaw a cang?
Zecawtamaw tatah a pathaipaw cawh nama suitei na cang.
Mingphing vytei a vong he ka,
na hme letah aa khuh aa panai a,
zecawtamaw tatah na raihrenah a dingpaw cawh a lang myca,”

content: Ma khy taico a hui neh ka, vaicung letei behnah ing, biatainah thingkawng chianahpaw thlangda a cangpaw cawh a honghlypaw khah ka hmuh.

Ruhanah rawrungpaw sangsarih khatei a cangpaw vaiming pasarih cawh behnah ing taico a ka pia he. Aaning sahlo cawh a pathaipaw pai le a tlypaw a hrei he ka, aa cacanghnaw letah sui cacanghnaw a tongchainah khah a pazai he.
Mataico hminghring sangpali letei pakheh takhei chaizaw tah chaizaw tai ahringpaw Khazing thingaená tah a chihpaw sui kaity sangsarih cawh vaiming pasarih khah a peh he.

Taico, behnah ing cawh Khazing rungnawnah mekhu le a hmingtuakhynah mekhu khei chih ka, vaiming pasarih tah ruhanah rawrungpaw sangsarih aa tlung sahpaw a chang hlai vytei cawh behnah ing chunglang ahohmai a nae khy bei he.
